notes.title: 0.8.2 Hotfix
notes.content:
Includes a bunch of fixes, quality of life improvements, tweaks and optimizations.

- You can now tick the disable nanite option which may(or may not) increase FPS. It should give a good performance gain for medium graphics settings.
- Fixes for low and medium graphics settings
- Removed "Very High" graphics settings. While technically visually more perfect, they don't provide a practical noticeable difference. Instead pursuing ray tracing in the future would yield better visual gains.
- Made it harder to double place climbing hooks by accident.
- Fixed lots of floating grass/objects.

A ton of other small fixes/improvements.

A big thank you to everybody who's been playtesting the game. A lot of these improvements come directly from your feedback.

notes.title: 0.81 Hotfix
notes.content:
Heya folks. This hotfix tackles the worst offenders.

Including:
- Some items/things placed where they shouldn't be.
- Flickering tip messages
- Certain world events staying longer than they should.
- Balances to degradation, repair kits and perishables.
- Fixes to grass flickering.

There'll be another hotfix coming soon after this one with more fixes.
